_comment: Target dagger attack gets +2{p}; if you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, INSTEAD +3{p}. Modeled as base +2 plus a conditional +1 gated on CONTROLS_CHAIN_LINKS attribute:Draconic amount:2 (=+3 when 2+ Draconic links). Prior JSON gated the WHOLE ability on the condition (no +2 when under 2 links) via CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE (chain links aren't tokens, and it ignores amount) and used an unrecognized 'additional_effects' key.
